globals.name: input-file
globals.description: Path to file containing JSON document input

operations.name: query
operations.description: Run one read-only SQL statement and return columns and rows as JSON

params.name: statement
params.description: Exactly one SQL statement (read-only: SELECT, WITH ... SELECT, read PRAGMA, EXPLAIN)

params.name: db
params.description: Path of the SQLite database file (or use connection)

params.name: connection
params.description: Name of a configured connection: the value of the environment variable LMSQL_<NAME>

params.name: maxRows
params.description: Return at most this many rows (1..10000); more set truncated: true

params.name: maxBytes
params.description: Cap on the serialized rows in bytes (1..16777216); hitting it sets truncated: true

params.name: timeoutMs
params.description: Abort the statement after this many milliseconds (1..300000), also the lock wait

operations.name: exec
operations.description: Run one SQL statement that changes data or schema; returns rows_affected and last_insert_rowid

params.name: statement
params.description: Exactly one SQL statement (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, CREATE, ...; RETURNING rows are returned)

params.name: db
params.description: Path of the SQLite database file (or use connection)

params.name: connection
params.description: Name of a configured connection: the value of the environment variable LMSQL_<NAME>

params.name: create
params.description: Create the SQLite database file if it does not exist

params.name: maxRows
params.description: Return at most this many rows (1..10000); more set truncated: true

params.name: maxBytes
params.description: Cap on the serialized rows in bytes (1..16777216); hitting it sets truncated: true

params.name: timeoutMs
params.description: Abort the statement after this many milliseconds (1..300000), also the lock wait
